answer:
Verdict: no

Across the whole trace (0–30,635.2 ms), filestore (PID 640560) had **zero reads of files outside its own folders**. Its file activity was on its own `data/records.dat` and `program.log`. At startup, the runtime also opened three shared-library/runtime files and read 2,048 bytes; the trace classifies these as startup activity, not unrelated file access.

The file-access totals are reported for the process as a whole, so they don’t identify which thread performed each access.
